issue: Password is not validated at sign-in; any password grants a session
actual: Signed in at /login with qatester01@example.com and deliberately wrong password 'wrongpass999'. App redirected to / and header shows 'New Thread / QaTester01', i.e. a fully logged-in session was created despite the incorrect password.

evidence: Registered QaTester01/qatester01@example.com/pass123 -> toast 'Account created! Welcome to ThreadHive!' and header showed logged-in user. Logged out (header reverted to Login/Register), logged back in with same credentials -> header shows 'New Thread / QaTester01'. Duplicate username and duplicate email both rejected with 'Username or email already exists'; 5-char password rejected with 'Password must be at least 6 characters'.

Edit Profile -> bio 'QA engineer testing ThreadHive forums.' and interests 'Testing, Automation, Coffee' saved; public profile page now renders the bio text and three interest tags (Testing / Automation / Coffee).

Empty form, whitespace-only title (with category+body), whitespace-only body (with category+title), and missing category (with title+body) were all rejected: toast 'Please fill in all fields', stayed on /new-thread, no thread created.

Created thread 'Zephyr Quest speedrun strategies' in Gaming; detail page /thread/thread-1787880294308 shows category Gaming, the exact title and body, author QaTester01. /category/gaming lists it alongside the other Gaming thread.

issue: Category and community counts are hard-coded fake numbers that never update
actual: Sidebar shows Gaming (312) but /category/gaming lists only 2 threads; totals show 1,045 Threads / 4,823 Replies / 892 Members while the forum actually contains 9 threads and 6 accounts. After registering a new member the Members count stayed 892, and after publishing a new Gaming thread the Gaming count stayed 312 and Threads stayed 1,045.

evidence: /category/gaming showed only the 2 Gaming threads (GameMaster42's indie games + new QaTester01 thread); switching to /category/tech changed the list to only the 2 Technology threads (mechanical keyboard, programming language 2024).

Search 'KEYBOARD' (uppercase) matched title 'Building a mechanical keyboard from scratch'; 'pomodoro' matched only body-text thread 'Share your favorite productivity tips!' with 'Showing results for "pomodoro"'; 'zzzqqxnomatch' returned 0 articles with 'No threads found. Try adjusting your search terms.'

On /thread/thread-7 posted a reply: toast 'Reply posted!', reply rendered immediately under 'Replies (1)' without reload, and the thread's displayed reply total went 41 -> 42. Post Reply button is disabled for empty input.

issue: Displayed reply total does not match the replies actually listed on the detail view
actual: /thread/thread-7 header showed '41 replies' while the detail view showed 'Replies (0) - No replies yet. Be the first to respond!'. After adding one reply the header showed '42 replies' but the list showed 'Replies (1)'. The seeded reply counts on every thread are fabricated numbers unrelated to the listed replies.

evidence: On TechExplorer's thread-7: upvote 92->93 with button switching to selected style (bg-primary/10 text-primary); clicking again removed the vote (93->92, unselected); re-voting returned 93 selected. Reply vote button also toggled 0->1 with selected state. Counts update immediately without reload.

Most Active list ordered strictly by reply count descending (89, 67, 45, 41, 38, 34, 31, 23, 0). After adding 5 replies to thread-7 (41 -> 46) it moved from 4th to 3rd, above 'Share your favorite productivity tips!' (45), confirming order updates with reply activity.

issue: No recent time window is stated or applied for Trending / Most Active
actual: 'Trending Discussions' and 'Most Active Discussions' both show the generic subtitle 'Join the conversation with our community'; no window (e.g. 'this week', 'last 24 hours') appears anywhere. Both lists rank by all-time totals — threads posted 'over 2 years ago' with lifetime upvote/reply counts dominate, while activity recency is ignored.

evidence: Clicked author link on a discussion -> /profile/user-1 showing username TechExplorer, bio, interests (Programming/Open Source/AI/ML/DevOps), 'Joined about 3 years ago', '2,450 reputation', and 'Threads by TechExplorer (2)' listing both authored threads. Reply entries on thread-7 also link to their author's profile.

Trending initially ordered by upvotes desc (156,124,92,89,78,67,56,47,0) with 'Building a mechanical keyboard' (92) ranked above 'Share your favorite productivity tips!' (89). After 4 distinct users upvoted the productivity thread (89->93) and the keyboard vote was removed (92), Trending re-ordered to 156,124,93,92,78,... with the productivity thread now above the keyboard thread.

After logging out (and other accounts logging in/out) and signing back in as QaTester01: profile still shows saved bio + interests (Testing/Automation/Coffee) and 'Threads by QaTester01 (1)' with the Zephyr Quest thread; thread-7 still lists the 5 QaTester01 replies with the reply upvote still selected (1); home list shows thread-2 upvote still selected for this user.

issue: No persistence — all user data is lost on page reload (state kept only in memory, localStorage/sessionStorage empty)
actual: After reloading http://localhost:6019/: header reverted to Login/Register (session lost); the created thread 'Zephyr Quest speedrun strategies' disappeared; thread-7 reply count reverted from 46 to 41 and its 5 replies were gone; thread-2 upvotes reverted from 93 to 89. Signing in again with the registered qatester01@example.com/pass123 was rejected with 'Invalid credentials. Try: tech@example.com', i.e. the registered account no longer exists. localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty.

issue: Unauthenticated access to thread creation renders a blank page instead of a sign-in screen
actual: While logged out, /new-thread renders a completely empty document (no header, no form, no login prompt, body text empty) and stays on /new-thread with no redirect after waiting. There is also no 'New Thread' entry point in the logged-out header, so an unauthenticated user gets no usable sign-in path or way back to discussion creation.
